commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A player from Leganes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+3' Now Las Palmas have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Juan Cruz and he is replaced by Duk (Leganes).
88' Substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) replaces Diego Garcia.
85' Dangerous play by Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes). Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. Las Palmas will take a free kick near the side line.
84' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' Alberto Moleiro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Diego Martin (Las Palmas).
81' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Oliver McBurnie is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
79' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Las Palmas.
78' The game has come to an end for Matija Nastasic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes).
76' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
76' Sergio Viera Garcia (Las Palmas) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
75' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
73' The attendance for today's match is 11279.
72' A substitution has been made. Dario Essugo is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
69' Yan Diomande (Leganes) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
66' Las Palmas concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. A free kick is awarded to Leganes.
65' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
61' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
59' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
55' Diego Garcia (Leganes) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
55' Here is a change. Viti is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Viera Garcia (Las Palmas).
51' Leganes have a goal ruled out for offside!
49' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) will not participate anymore and Sandro Ramirez is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Borja Jimenez gives a chance to Oscar Rodriguez and Dani Raba (Leganes) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Jose Sanchez starts the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Leganes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Renato Tapia (Leganes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
42' Dinko Horkas is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Yan Diomande (Leganes). Easy save!
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Leganes, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
40' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
37' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
36' Adria Altimira (Leganes) receives a yellow card for infringement.
35' The Las Palmas players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' The linesman signals a throw-in for Leganes.
32' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul after Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) hacks down one of his opponents. Leganes win a free kick.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' A cross into the box from Juan Cruz (Leganes) is cleared.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
25' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Marvin (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Jose Sanchez stops the game and makes a call. Leganes are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
20' Munir El Haddadi is being substituted because of an injury. Borja Jimenez sends Yan Diomande (Leganes) on the pitch.
19' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' The resulting set piece from Leganes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
15' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) gets a yellow card, off the field.
13' Adria Altimira (Leganes) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
11' Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' 0 - 1 Referee Jose Sanchez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Leganes players celebrate.
8' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
7' Dani Raba (Leganes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
4' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.

3' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
2' Leganes couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Dinko Horkas (Las Palmas) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
1' The match has just started.
Leganes will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will officiate today.
